title: Three Years and One Short Brief
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：justice　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 justice 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the barrister ① sought the justice that no witness in the courtroom would have recorded, and he said the seeking was the whole of the year. The ② justice, meaning the right itself and not the brief, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; justice, he said, is the only thing in a courtroom that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of justice in that courtroom had the same short brief beside it, and the ④ justice at the far bench, meaning the ruling they kept for the children to read and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Justice, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the barrister said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the justice was the whole of the matter, meaning the law and not the right. The ⑥ justice, meaning the law and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; justice, he said, is either something you seek or the only word that means both right and a law. He said the law is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ justice had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short brief. The ⑧ justice of the whole thing, the barrister wrote in October, was one courtroom and three years of recording; justice, he said, is either the ruling at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ justice I remember is the justice recorded in the register, which closed in 1986 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtroom. ⑩ Justice, my mother said in 1988, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all justice, she said, is a law that has agreed to look like right. She said the law was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 正义；公正（指审判庭里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 正义；公正（指那份公道本身，与案卷相对）
C. 固定搭配：seek the justice 寻求这份正义
D. n. 正义；公正（指留给孩子们读的一则那一份）
E. n. 司法之事（抽象总称，指一处审判庭的正义之事）
F. n. 正义；公正（指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 法度、天理（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 天理（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sought the justice that no witness in the courtroom would have recorded
The justice, meaning the right itself and not the brief
Every kind of justice in that courtroom
the justice at the far bench
the justice was the whole of the matter
the justice had become a line in a register
The justice of the whole thing

answers.why: seek the justice 意为“寻求这份正义”，1979 年那位辩护人把审判庭里没有一位证人肯记录的一份正义做了一遍。
justice 意为“正义；公正”，指那份公道本身而不是案卷，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被记录。
justice 意为“正义；公正”，指审判庭里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一卷薄薄的案卷。
justice 意为“正义；公正”，指最远那条长凳留给孩子们读的一则那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
justice 意为“法度、天理”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份法度就是那件事的全部。
justice 意为“天理”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份公道，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
justice 意为“正义；公正”，指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1984 年这一份成了登记册里的一行。
justice 意为“司法之事”，辩护人十月写道，整件事的正义之事是一处审判庭和三个年的记录。
justice 意为“正义；公正”，我记得的是登记册里记录过的那一份，1986 年落定了，至今仍被说成审判庭里最安静的一份。
justice 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，正义是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的公道。
